title: Puppet Master Browser Capture Typed Companion
description: V2 static typed contracts for the eight existing Browser capture/DevTools routes declared in Plans/Commands_System.md:5979-5986. V2 supersedes the unlanded v1 companion with independently resolved caller/original/buffer/current inputs, an authentic CommandOutcomeRecord, and a drift-checked central envelope; owner prose, command pairs, handlers, handler_unavailable and event non-admission are unchanged. Routes: cmd.browser.capture.full_to_chat, cmd.browser.capture.region_to_chat, cmd.browser.component.pick, cmd.browser.component.send_now, cmd.browser.component.add_to_composer, cmd.browser.component.insert_at_cursor, cmd.browser.component.mode.set_default, cmd.browser.devtools.open. Behavior is owned by Plans/Section15_MVP_Promoted_Features_Spec.md Additive Correction v4 (BSTALE-001..012), Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md Browser capture and DevTools table, Plans/Scheduling_and_Quota_Resume.md SMSG-007..011 (frozen snapshots), Plans/assistant-chat-design.md (ComposerBuffer/composer destination), Plans/Settings_System.md (Settings transaction) and Plans/Contracts_V0.md#CV-333 (central UICommandResponse). All rows stay handler_unavailable; expected_event_types boundaries are unchanged; no EventRecord, storage writer, native dispatcher, or runtime proof is claimed. Each payload carries its unique record-addressable schema_id.

capture_scope.description: Viewport is the default; full_page requires explicit user selection (semantic J_SCOPE_DEFAULT).

origin_security_class.description: Protected-auth origin must be denied (semantic J_PROTECTED); the subject itself stays ordinary-shaped.

capture_details.description: BSTALE-009: bounded Details exposing original page/session/generation, capture time, identity hints and reason. Semantic J_DETAILS rejects secrets, cookies, credentials, tokens and absolute paths.

code.description: Commands_System CS-078 vocabulary plus browser-typed stale_capture, protected_denied, schedule_refused_live_selector and source_changed. handler_unavailable is preserved as a truthful state.

command_id.description: BSTALE-004: recapture reuses the picker; cmd.browser.component.recapture is never minted.

stable_locator.description: Opaque stable locator identity. No locator-strategy taxonomy is invented; revalidation compares ref and hash exactly.

source_identity.description: BSTALE-011: source-map/source-file identity disclosed even when the DOM locator still resolves.

component_selection.description: Exact captured component identity. BSTALE-010: captured_at is provenance only; currentness is generation/identity based, never timestamp based.

BrowserComponentSendRequest.description: BSTALE-001: revalidated immediately before dispatch against live session/page/frame/generation/locator/tag/role/component/source/fingerprint.

destroyed.description: True when the frame or page was destroyed.

component_revalidation.description: Field names follow BSTALE-001 pm.browser.component_revalidation_result.v1 (attachment_id, captured_generation, current_generation, locator_result_count, identity_match, result, recapture_action) plus source_match and destroyed for BSTALE-003/011.

MessageAdmissionResult.description: TECHNICAL GAP (explicit): no staged MessageAdmission owner schema establishes a message-admission record shape; this join carries only the browser-owned admission verdict (outcome/message_ref/revalidation/isolation) and the exact composer destination. Native MessageAdmission stays unproved.

composer_list_entry.description: BSTALE-005: numbered structured list entry with hidden per-item ref; each item revalidated independently.

flattened.description: Must be false: the chip is never flattened into plain text (semantic J_CHIP).

partial_send_without_explicit_action.description: Must always be false: a partial list is never sent without explicit action (semantic J_PARTIAL).

ComposerBufferResult.description: TECHNICAL GAP (explicit): no staged ComposerBuffer owner schema establishes buffer/entry record shapes; this join carries only the browser-owned structured list/chip verdict with hidden refs and revision/epoch fences. Native ComposerBuffer stays unproved. This result has no message/send field by construction.

initial_mode.description: Companion-local encoding of the three owner-described dispositions (send straight away / numbered composer list / insert at cursor) of Plans/settings_inventory.json#planning.testing.browser-component-action. The inventory registers the key, label, default and prose but no option-value vocabulary; these spellings are NOT claimed as owner-registered (see prerequisite proposal).

setting_id_ref.description: Must equal the registered Plans/settings_inventory.json key planning.testing.browser-component-action; enforced causally by the validator against the live inventory (J_SETTINGS_KEY), never by shape const.

outcome.description: Subset of the Settings owner outcomes (settings_transaction_result); no new outcome is introduced.

changed_setting_ids.description: At most the one persisted mode setting; no new state or policy (semantic J_SETTINGS).

disabled_reasons.description: Shape mirrors the Settings owner disabled_reasons; the closed reason vocabulary stays with the Settings owner.

SettingsTransactionResult.description: Browser join through the existing Settings owner transaction/version/currentness path. The staged settings_transaction_result closes command_id to cmd.settings.transaction.apply/rollback, so this join reuses its revision/outcome/receipt shape with the browser command identity instead of copying the owner record.

raw_protocol_authority_granted.description: Must always be false: no raw CDP authority (semantic J_DEVTOOLS).

program_evaluate_authority_granted.description: Must always be false: no program/evaluate authority (semantic J_DEVTOOLS).

RouteResult.description: Ordinary internal DevTools navigation only. No runtime admission, raw protocol, or page-evaluate capability is carried.

precondition_snapshot.description: Exact UI_Command_Catalog preconditions per route; every named surface reads the same owner availability.

live_browser_state.description: Live browser/composer/settings state at dispatch, supplied by the native owners at runtime. Static fixtures bind request, current and result so revalidation, fencing and isolation joins are causal.

central_error.description: Verbatim mirror of Plans/ui_command_response.schema.json#/$defs/UICommandError. Drift-checked against the live owner schema by the validator.

central_response.description: Verbatim structural mirror of the Plans/ui_command_response.schema.json v2 envelope (required fields, enums, consts, coherence rules). Owner $refs that resolve in this companion's registry (full-thread Id/IdentityEnvelope/OwnerResultSchemaRef/UtcTimestamp) are referenced directly; NonSecretRef-typed leaves use central_opaque_ref because that owner file is not staged in this detached job and its exact pattern was not verified. Drift-checked against the live owner schema by the validator; any owner change fails the check rather than silently diverging.

central_opaque_ref.description: Opaque owner reference leaf (stands in for the unstaged NonSecretRef owner type; no upper bound or pattern is claimed).

central_command_id.description: Verbatim mirror of the owner CommandId pattern.

surface.description: Exact UI_Command_Catalog source surfaces for this family.

caller_context.description: Independently resolved caller record: the dispatch instance, request, raising surface and permission snapshot the outcome/central records must agree with. Never equated across unlike owner identity kinds.

issuer_receipt_ref.description: Receipt of the cmd.browser.component.pick result that originally issued this capture.

original_capture.description: Independently resolved original: the picker-issued capture the caller's request copy must match and live state is revalidated against. Required for send_now/add_to_composer/insert_at_cursor; null otherwise.

buffer_original.description: Independently resolved per-item ComposerBuffer original: hidden ref bound to the exact originally captured component plus independent current generation/validity. BSTALE-005/006 structured identity.

dispatch_source.description: Minimal technical resolver contract for the dispatcher-selected original (SIR original-custody rule, Shared_Integration_Runtime.md around line 2705): full IdentityEnvelope, command/instance/operation, dispatch ID, idempotency, target generation, accepted time, exact selected arguments and permission snapshot. The payload digest is computed over the arguments object alone; the companion request copy is never the digest source. Native dispatcher authentication remains unproved.

schedule_gate.description: BSTALE-007/SMSG-009: a scheduled send needs a frozen snapshot with immutable artifact identity, else scheduling is refused.

browser_capture_response_case.description: Complete eight-route validation record binding the exact request, independently resolved caller/original/buffer/current records, typed result, authentic CommandOutcomeRecord, drift-checked central envelope and schedule gate. Owner $refs resolve through the aggregate offline registry at root. This record carries no event refs, storage writes, or native proof by construction.
